title.narrative: Promotion of human rights and gender equality in business

description.narrative: Business can be a powerful driver of sustainable development by providing jobs, making a positive contribution to local infrastructure, thereby improving access to social and economic opportunities. Many companies in Kazakhstan already have extensive practices in implementing responsible business principles through the development and adoption of separate policies on gender equality, human rights or sustainable development. To prepare for upcoming international rules and regulations and ensure greater attention to the promotion of gender equality and human rights, the project offers a unique package of measures to the Centre for Social Cooperation and Communications to strengthen the capacity of human rights due diligence (HRDD) and gender equality for its portfolio companies in Kazakhstan. The introduction of standards will help to increase the effectiveness of company policies to ensure the rights and opportunities of men and women, and to create a clear mechanism for monitoring and evaluating the implementation of national and international obligations. The methodology and tools are developed in line with the generally recognized principles laid down in international treaties and agreements.

participating-org.narrative: The Center for Social Cooperation and Communications

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
